meta.name: ab-strathcona-demo
meta.note: Route is a real pipeline way from OpenStreetMap near Edmonton (OSM tags it Trans-Northern; not verified, and no operator is involved), cached from a laptop run because Overpass times out from n8n Cloud. Weather history and climate projections are cached per 10 km cell from a laptop run. Scores come from n8n W2. Route, slope and NDVI are from the live n8n tables. The hazard scores were recomputed on a laptop with the Score Segments code from the W2 export, the cached Open-Meteo climate cells and the mapped OSM crossings, to include refreshed climate cells without claiming a new live n8n execution.

snapshot.note: Route, slope and NDVI are from the live n8n tables. The hazard scores were recomputed on a laptop with the Score Segments code from the W2 export, the cached Open-Meteo climate cells and the mapped OSM crossings, to include refreshed climate cells without claiming a new live n8n execution. Solar irradiance comes from the separately downloaded NASA POWER climatology cache; grid proximity remains unavailable where not measured.
